name: Mukunoki Lili
source:
"Then, it's fine to call you sensei, isn't it? Right? [url=/c124651]Hina-sensei[/url]."

A well-rounded first-year student in the Knight Training Department. Influenced by her [url=/c124985]older sister[/url], she started to learn fencing at an early age, and becomes unmatched among the first-year students. She calls the assistant instructor Hina, "Sensei," while keeping a certain distance and gets involved with him moderately​. 

[Translated and edited from the [url=http://www.ensemble-game.com/29.otohime/character_lili.html]official website[/url]]
